name: How long does tile floor installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does tile floor installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most tile projects take longer than a simple room repaint because prep and cure time matter. Small rooms may finish in a day or two, while larger areas, demolition, leveling, or moisture-related repairs can add several more days.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small tile jobs may take a day or two, but bigger projects can take several days once prep, setting, and curing time are included. Subfloor repairs can extend the schedule.
